lines.en: My four feet land and the ground shakes.
My long neck moves through the trees.

lines.zh: 我踩过一块石头,它碎了
lines.en: I step on a stone and it breaks.
The young sauropods follow me.
My tail sweeps through the shrubs.
I head for the tender leaves up high.
My feet sink half an inch into the soil.
My herd moves in a loose line.
Step by step, I shake leaves loose.
I raise my head to the canopy.

lines.zh: 我从两棵树之间挤过去
lines.en: I squeeze between two trees.

lines.zh: 脚下踩碎的东西卡进土里
lines.en: What I crush stays pressed into the soil.
I walk around the pond.

lines.zh: 脖子一低,影子就盖住地面
lines.en: When my neck lowers, my shadow covers the ground.
I lead the herd to the sunny slope.

lines.zh: 六丈高的身影慢慢挪动
lines.en: A figure several blocks tall moves slowly.

lines.zh: 我站着,像一棵会喘的树
lines.en: I stand like a breathing tree.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着高处的叶子
lines.en: I chew leaves from up high.
My neck crosses the canopy.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我的重量压实
lines.en: My weight packs the earth beneath me.
I look at the clouds far off.
The young nudge my leg.
I swing my tail once.

lines.zh: 我抬头，够到最高的树冠。
lines.en: I raise my head to reach the highest canopy.

lines.zh: 我呼吸时,胸腔很大地起伏
lines.en: My chest rises widely as I breathe.
I lower my head to the ground.
This tree could feed me all day.
I stand quietly, out of the way.

lines.zh: 咽下去的时候喉咙很响
lines.en: My throat sounds loudly when I swallow.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，赶走虫蝇。
lines.en: I swish my tail to drive off flies.
You are not as tall as my leg.
I lower my head to you, slowly.
Standing by my feet is not safe.
I try to stay still.
You do not look like a predator.

lines.zh: 我抬起脖子,让你看清我
lines.en: I raise my neck so you can see me.
You stepped back; that is good.

lines.zh: 我认得这片林子的每一棵
lines.en: I know every tree in this wood.
Would you stand farther off?
My eyes sit on the sides of my head.
I do not mind your looking.
I blow a breath from my nose.
My long neck jerks back.
I step back and trees snap.
A cut has opened in my hide.
I shake my head to throw the pain off.
The young are calling over there.
I turn slowly around.

lines.zh: 我脚下的石头，会被踩碎。
lines.en: The stones under my feet crack.
I can still stand here.
Blood falls on the leaves.
I do not like being struck.
Those leaves are very tender.
My head has come down.
These are not a mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我这长脖子，够到最高的叶。
lines.en: This long neck reaches the highest leaves.
I tilt my head your way.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻脚边的嫩枝。
lines.en: I lower my head to sniff the young shoots.
I stretch my long neck toward it.
The ones on the tree taste better.

lines.zh: 我低下长脖子，凑近看看。
lines.en: I lower my long neck to take a closer look.
Do not stand directly beneath.
You hit my leg like a tree.

lines.zh: 我这长脖子一伸，就够到树顶。
lines.en: One stretch of my long neck reaches the treetops.
I move one leg aside.
That I do not mind.
My leg pushed you back.
Careful; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 地面被我们一起踩得下沉
lines.en: The ground sinks under us both.
My tail caught you.
One step of mine dents the ground.
Move over to one side.
We stand side by side in the wood.

lines.zh: 我的脖子绕过去碰你的
lines.en: My neck curves over to yours.
The young circle at our feet.
We feed on this tree together.
I keep watch; you sleep first.
This wood can feed a herd.
You lead; I bring up the herd.
Both of us walk slowly.
With you here, I need not hurry.
We go back before dark.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌踩碎了一块石头。
lines.en: My foot crushes a stone to pieces.
Not even a mouthful for me.
Two chews and it is gone.
I stepped on it; it broke.
I push it aside.
I cannot eat this.
I still have leaves in my mouth.
I nudge it under the tree.
Too small to matter.
I leave it for the young.

lines.zh: 我注意到你在我的林子里
lines.en: I notice you in my wood.

lines.zh: 我的前腿抬起，又重重落下。
lines.en: My foreleg lifts and comes down hard.
The young move behind me.
These trees are mine.
I do not like being pressed.
I lower my neck to look at you
One step from me cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子已经探到你头顶。
lines.en: My long neck already reaches over your head.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压平成一条线。
lines.en: I flatten my neck into a line.
My herd is watching too.

lines.zh: 我四脚踏地，震得土粒跳。
lines.en: I plant all four feet; soil grains jump.

lines.zh: 这次我不退了，脖子压低。
lines.en: This time I don't back off. Neck lowered.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子压低,朝你这边
lines.en: I lower my long neck your way.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被我一脚踩平
lines.en: One step of mine flattens the grass.
I swing my head with your direction.
You cannot outrun my stride.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直在你上方
lines.en: My shadow stays above you.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，树都晃一下。
lines.en: Each step I take shakes the trees.
Trees are pushed aside beside me.
I am slow, but the ground is small.
You have reached the wood's edge.
I lift a forefoot, then set it down.
The ground has not stopped shaking.
The young are hidden.
I shift one more step forward.
Do not rush; I am not rushing.
This will be a long one.

lines.zh: 你听见树断的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the tree snap?
I stop upwind of you.
My forefoot comes down hard.
The ground splits.
My neck sweeps across.
You are sent flying.
My tail follows through.
Two trees have snapped.
This blow was not quick.
Dust covers you.
I raise the other foot.
Do not lie where I step.
I step back to see clearly.
This one is for the young.
The print left behind is deep.
Far enough; I will not chase.
The ground begins to shake first.
The canopy is pushed open.
My two forefeet land.
Dust rises above the shrubs.
My long neck shows above the trees.
The herd arrives behind me.
The young press against my legs.

lines.zh: 我抬脚,踩在一块石头上
lines.en: I set my foot on a stone.
That stone has cracked.
I lower my head and see the wood.
These trees are tender.
I call once, very low.
A few leaves fall.
I shift my body.
The wood has fallen quiet.
I take one more step forward.
I know this stretch.
Those standing far, stay clear.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的脖子往上烧
lines.en: Fire climbs my neck.

lines.zh: 我这么重摔下来,震塌了土
lines.en: This weight crashing down caves the earth.

lines.zh: 水只到我的膝,我却站不稳
lines.en: The water is knee-deep, and I cannot stand.
The blast twists my neck aside.

lines.zh: 一根东西扎进我的侧腹
lines.en: Something lodges in my flank.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我骨头里嗡嗡响
lines.en: That force hums in my bones.

lines.zh: 这么大一具身体,饿起来很快
lines.en: Such a large body starves quickly.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的长脖子下来
lines.en: Lightning runs down my long neck.
None of my four feet find ground.
